write_up: Your resume makes a strong case for senior FP&A work! At Lakeshore Foods, you connect forecasting and pricing to changes a recruiter can understand, alongside ownership of a $240M division budget.

The driver-based forecast is the best model: it names what you built and shows forecast error before and after. Your progression from Financial Analyst to Senior Financial Analyst is easy to follow, and Experience is in the right place above Education.

I'd send this resume as it is. For a more senior role, bring the forecast result to the top of the Lakeshore bullets and add a budget decision you made if you can substantiate one. How competitive the role is will still matter.
